logical_allocation.safe_height_formula: H_safe = viewport_height_dp - safe_insets_top_dp - safe_insets_bottom_dp; consume each safe inset exactly once before computing H_safe.

typography.base_size_formula: clamp(safeHeightDp * role_ratio, role_min_sp, role_max_sp) * viewportScale; emit as Compose sp
typography.system_font_scale_rule: Compose applies system fontScale once through sp rendering. fontScale may inform wrapping, gap pressure and measured-height budgets, but must not be multiplied into TextStyle a second time.

roles.size_formula: Approved image artwork; width clamp(safeWidthDp*155/1080,46,70)dp; height ratio 80:155.
roles.system_font_scale: No font scaling of image artwork.

wrapping_rules: Species may wrap to at most two lines when target card width < 240dp or systemFontScale >= 1.3; otherwise use the existing single-line policy unless content measurement requires the declared local wrap.

Measurements and auxiliary metadata may use up to two lines in the constrained/high-font cases. A long metadata string may require two lines even when its width/font threshold alone does not trigger wrapping.
Preserve species, positive measurement values with units, and time before optional location. Shorten/ellipsize optional location first.
Never leave a lone final CJK glyph or dangling separator. hasVisualOverflow=false alone is not proof that the final line is visually acceptable.

formulas.stats_to_title: max(minimum_gap_dp, interpolate(base_curve over safeHeightDp) - font_pressure_penalty_dp*fontPressure); the configured curve is continuous at its control points.
formulas.title_to_card_runtime: max(minimum_gap_dp, interpolate(base_curve over safeHeightDp) - font_pressure_penalty_dp*fontPressure); the configured curve passes through the four declared static anchor targets and is continuous between them.
formulas.cta_to_camera: Piecewise-linear interpolation of preview_engine.parameters.spacing.footer.transition_curve over safeHeightDp; clamp to endpoint values.
formulas.footer_top_padding: Piecewise-linear interpolation of preview_engine.parameters.spacing.footer.transition_curve over safeHeightDp; clamp to endpoint values.
formulas.footer_bottom_padding: Piecewise-linear interpolation of the inset-appropriate bottom-padding values in preview_engine.parameters.spacing.footer.transition_curve over safeHeightDp; clamp to endpoint values.

conflict_resolution.topic: Frozen master raster versus responsive runtime geometry
conflict_resolution.decision: The original PNG owns the approved visible composition and hierarchy at its reference; responsive geometry is resolved from this contract and actual constraints, not by scaling absolute coordinates to every viewport.

conflict_resolution.topic: Static archive V1 versus active Gemini route
conflict_resolution.decision: V1 retains frozen image identity, provenance, labels and static archive presentation. V2 is the proposed single responsive behavior contract for generated previews and the current Gemini route after canonical adoption.

conflict_resolution.topic: Legacy fixed-coordinate Layout Responsive Contract versus Gemini V3
conflict_resolution.decision: The legacy Layout_Responsive_Contract_V1 applies only to the legacy NormalHomeContent route and pixel/touch anchor evidence. Gemini V3 uses the Top/Middle/Footer content-first model defined here.

conflict_resolution.topic: M05 480dp width-only static target versus Android runtime
conflict_resolution.decision: The 480dp M05 target is static-only and excluded from the 24-case Android matrix until a real native height is explicitly defined and the runtime contract is revised.
ADAPTIVE_V2 is the production target; V3_BASELINE remains a comparison arm; ADAPTIVE_V1 is non-authoritative for this route.

conflict_resolution.topic: Responsive numeric rules duplicated between Markdown and machine contract
conflict_resolution.decision: This JSON is the only machine authority for responsive numeric parameters. The Markdown guide explains it; the static V1 documents remain immutable provenance and archive records.
Specification status and Android runtime status are independent. This contract cannot change NOT_VERIFIED to PASS; only exact-SHA native evidence can.

conflict_resolution.topic: Viewport screenshot dimensions versus logical dp
conflict_resolution.decision: Source PNG canvas pixels, browser preview pixels and logical dp are distinct coordinate spaces. The 1080x1920px master maps to 360x640dp at 3x; it is not a 1080x1920dp runtime profile.

implementation_conformance_followups.issue: The current helper selects the 124dp minimum floor using a broad safeHeight/fontScale predicate; the normative exception is limited to the exact 320x480dp profile at fontScale=1.0 with width/readability/no-scroll conditions.
implementation_conformance_followups.required_action: During implementation conformance, align the helper with the exact exception and prove it with boundary tests; do not broaden the contract to match the helper.

implementation_conformance_followups.issue: Long metadata can receive two rendered lines from the metadata-length rule while the current minimum-height estimate is primarily driven by the font/width wrap flag.
implementation_conformance_followups.required_action: Include the actual permitted metadata line budget in Hero readability sizing and verify real TextLayoutResult line ranges.

implementation_conformance_followups.issue: The native acceptance matrix must prove monotonicity for all key text roles, Hero width and camera artwork at the same system fontScale; static preview alone is insufficient.
implementation_conformance_followups.required_action: Retain and extend exact-SHA native assertions and record computed role sizes and bounds for each matrix case.

change_log.change: Consolidate one constraint-driven responsive policy; bind all six frozen visual anchors; resolve static/archive, legacy-layout, Gemini runtime, M05 width-only and status semantics; define deterministic browser preview parameters, continuous spacing curves and contract-owned text-wrap thresholds; retain Android runtime as NOT_VERIFIED.

Browser audit showed short-screen height pressure shrinking the Hero below its declared width floor and 1.3x metadata occupying three lines. Raise the readable Hero floor to 220dp (185dp at the declared aspect ratio) and permit Middle-only scrolling while Footer remains pinned; keep frozen image assets unchanged.
